content: <thought>We need three retrosynthetic steps: (1) disconnect the amide C(=O)N to give the α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid and an aniline; (2) disconnect the α,β‑unsaturated acid via a Doebner modification to give an aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid; (3) disconnect the sulfonamide to give the sulfonyl chloride and the aniline that bears the methyl‑phenyl group. We will locate suitable template IDs for each transformation using the catalog and then construct the JSON route.</thought>
